zh: 克里米亚领导人表示，俄罗斯与被占领土之间的线路再次遭到袭击后，交通中断。

en: Hamas condemns the incursion, which the Israeli military says is dismantling a "terror tunnel", as a "flagrant" ceasefire violation.
zh: 哈马斯谴责这次入侵，以色列军方称这次入侵正在拆除“恐怖隧道”，这是“公然”违反停火协议。

en: The multi-billionaire also said he was "not Maga", distancing himself from the political movement linked to Trump.
zh: 这位亿万富翁还表示，他“不是马加”，与与特朗普有关的政治运动保持距离。

en: The suspect followed employees and was found with fake US IDs and two Russian passports, prosecutors say.
zh: 检察官称，嫌疑人跟踪员工，被发现持有假美国身份证和两本俄罗斯护照。

en: Inass Touloub's body was found along the A10 road in 1987, bearing marks of abuse, and was not identified until 2018.
zh: Inass Touloub 的尸体于 1987 年在 A10 公路沿线被发现，身上有被虐待的痕迹，直到 2018 年才被确认身份。

en: The meeting in New Delhi was a late addition to the royal couple's India visit, which also included their appearance at the annual Earthshot Prize
zh: 这次在新德里举行的会面是这对王室夫妇访问印度的最后一次访问，他们还出席了一年一度的 Earthshot 奖

en: Bahrain says it was also attacked by Iran following a US air strike on the Iranian island of Qeshm in the Gulf on Tuesday.
zh: 巴林表示，美国周二对海湾地区的伊朗格什姆岛发动空袭后，巴林也遭到了伊朗的袭击。

en: The purchase has sparked outrage over its cost as many Ghanaians struggle with rising cost of living.
zh: 由于许多加纳人正在努力应对不断上涨的生活成本，此次购买引发了对其成本的愤怒。

en: The nomination sets him on the path to become the first black lawmaker to lead the chamber when Democrats take control of the House in January.
zh: 这项提名使他有望成为民主党一月份控制众议院时第一位领导众议院的黑人议员。

en: The 83-year-old singer is accused of abusing two former employees at Caribbean residences in 2021.
zh: 这位 83 岁的歌手被指控于 2021 年在加勒比住宅虐待两名前雇员。

en: Confirmation of Mary Peltola's victory caps of the party's rout of the Republicans in the midterms Senate election.
zh: 玛丽·佩尔托拉（Mary Peltola）获胜的确认标志着该党在参议院中期选举中击败共和党。

en: Cameron Bancroft claims the whole Australia team knew about the 2018 sandpaper plot in explosive revelations that will heap pressure on current captain Pat Cummins.
zh: 卡梅伦·班克罗夫特声称整个澳大利亚队都知道 2018 年砂纸阴谋的爆炸性爆料，这将给现任队长帕特·康明斯带来压力。

en: Tyler Buchanan, from Dundee, was a member of the notorious Scattered Spider group and began hacking when he was a teenager.
zh: 来自邓迪的泰勒·布坎南 (Tyler Buchanan) 是臭名昭著的“分散蜘蛛”组织的成员，十几岁时就开始从事黑客活动。

en: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.
zh: 在黄仁勋大幅退出后，这家人工智能芯片巨头周二公布了强劲的季度收益。

en: The decision comes after California banned Waymo's driverless vehicles from operating on the state's highways following a series of traffic incidents.
zh: 这一决定是在发生一系列交通事故后，加州禁止 Waymo 的无人驾驶汽车在该州高速公路上运营的。

en: Asif Merchant was found guilty in March of trying to hire undercover FBI agents as hitmen to assassinate US officials, including the president.
zh: 阿西夫·麦钱特 (Asif Merchant) 三月份被判有罪，罪名是试图雇佣联邦调查局 (FBI) 卧底特工作为杀手暗杀包括总统在内的美国官员。

en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there was "zero evidence" supporting theories online that recent disruptions affecting Microsoft, banks and flights are connected.
zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，“零证据”支持网上的理论，即最近影响微软、银行和航班的中断是有关联的。

en: The $60m (£45m) plane was destroyed in an hours-long raid by an anti-war protester, according to the FBI.
zh: 据联邦调查局称，这架价值 6000 万美元（4500 万英镑）的飞机在一名反战抗议者长达数小时的突袭中被摧毁。

en: The vehicles currently operate in 15 US cities, though freeway rides are only offered in a handful, including San Francisco and Los Angeles.
zh: 这些车辆目前在美国 15 个城市运营，但只有少数城市提供高速公路乘车服务，其中包括旧金山和洛杉矶。

en: The Prince and Princess of Wales ended their three-day trip to India on Wednesday, the couple's first international tour since 2022.
zh: 威尔士王子和王妃周三结束了为期三天的印度之旅，这是这对夫妇自 2022 年以来的首次国际旅行。

en: BBC Verify analyses footage showing the final moments before part of the bridge fell and videos showing the scale of destruction.
zh: BBC verify 分析了显示桥梁部分倒塌前最后时刻的镜头以及显示破坏规模的视频。

en: Zookeepers say she cannot have surgery but are providing fluids and supportive care to help her pass the hat.
zh: 动物园管理员表示她无法接受手术，但正在为她提供液体和支持性护理，以帮助她顺利通过手术。

en: The BBC’s Laura Bicker, Steve Rosenberg and Nada Tawfik explain everything you need to know ahead of the unprecedented trilateral meeting.
zh: BBC 的劳拉·比克 (Laura Bicker)、史蒂夫·罗森伯格 (Steve Rosenberg) 和纳达·陶菲克 (Nada Tawfik) 在这场史无前例的三边会议之前解释了您需要了解的一切。

en: Ukrainian forces are fighting Russian troops in an old Soviet tunnel in the Kharkiv region.
zh: 乌克兰军队正在哈尔科夫地区的一条旧苏联隧道中与俄罗斯军队作战。

en: India will remain predominantly Hindu, though its Muslim population is projected to grow faster, according to a new survey.
zh: 根据一项新的调查，印度仍将以印度教徒为主，尽管其穆斯林人口预计增长更快。

en: Anthropic's hotly anticipated IPO is expected to put it in the top 10 most valuable US companies, but the future is uncertain.
zh: Anthropic备受期待的IPO有望跻身美国最有价值公司前10名，但未来充满不确定性。

en: The Lobito Corridor is at the centre of a US-backed effort to secure access to Africa's critical minerals.
zh: 洛比托走廊是美国支持的确保获取非洲关键矿产的努力的中心。

en: The 2023 Cricket World Cup final takes place at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad, India, played between host nation India and Australia.
zh: 2023 年板球世界杯决赛在印度艾哈迈达巴德的纳伦德拉·莫迪体育场举行，东道主印度和澳大利亚之间进行比赛。

en: A gunman kills five and injures 17 at Club Q, a gay nightclub in Colorado Springs, Colorado.
zh: 一名枪手在科罗拉多州科罗拉多斯普林斯的一家同性恋夜总会 Club Q 中造成 5 人死亡、17 人受伤。

en: A double suicide bombing at the Iranian embassy in Beirut kills 23 people and injures 160 others.
zh: 伊朗驻贝鲁特大使馆发生双重自杀式爆炸事件，造成 23 人死亡、160 人受伤。

en: The first of four explosions takes place at the Pike River Mine in New Zealand. Twenty-nine people are killed in the nation's worst mining disaster since 1914.
zh: 四起爆炸中的第一起发生在新西兰的派克河矿井。 29 人在该国自 1914 年以来最严重的矿难中丧生。

en: The worst brawl in NBA history results in several players being suspended. Several players and fans are charged with assault and battery.
zh: NBA历史上最严重的斗殴事件导致多名球员被停赛。一些球员和球迷被指控袭击和殴打。

en: Shenzhou 1: The People's Republic of China launches its first Shenzhou spacecraft.
zh: 神舟一号：中华人民共和国发射第一艘神舟飞船。

en: John Carpenter becomes the first person to win the top prize in the TV game show Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?
zh: 约翰·卡彭特 (John Carpenter) 成为电视游戏节目《谁想成为百万富翁？》中第一个获得最高奖项的人。

en: Clinton–Lewinsky scandal: The United States House of Representatives Judiciary Committee begins impeachment hearings into U.S. President Bill Clinton.
zh: 克林顿-莱温斯基丑闻：美国众议院司法委员会开始针对美国总统比尔·克林顿的弹劾听证会。

en: A Beechcraft 1900 and a Beechcraft King Air collide at Quincy Regional Airport in Quincy, Illinois, killing 14.
zh: 一架 Beechcraft 1900 和一架 Beechcraft King Air 在伊利诺伊州昆西地区机场相撞，造成 14 人死亡。

en: In the United Kingdom, the first National Lottery draw is held. A £1 ticket gave a one-in-14-million chance of correctly guessing the winning six out of 49 numbers.
zh: 在英国，举行了第一次国家彩票抽奖。一张 1 英镑的彩票，正确猜出 49 个号码中的 6 个中奖号码的几率为 1400 万分之一。

en: A factory fire killed 87 and injured 51 in Shenzhen, China.
zh: 中国深圳发生工厂火灾，造成 87 人死亡、51 人受伤。

en: Cold War: In Geneva, U.S. President Ronald Reagan and Soviet Union General Secretary Mikhail Gorbachev meet for the first time.
zh: 冷战：在日内瓦，美国总统罗纳德·里根和苏联总书记米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫首次会面。

en: Police in Baling, Malaysia, lay siege to houses occupied by an Islamic sect of about 400 people led by Ibrahim Mahmud.
zh: 马来西亚华陵警方包围易卜拉欣·马哈茂德领导的约 400 人的伊斯兰教派占据的房屋。

en: San Juanico disaster: A series of explosions at the Pemex petroleum storage facility at San Juan Ixhuatepec in Mexico City starts a major fire and kills about 500 people.
zh: 圣胡安尼科灾难：墨西哥城圣胡安伊克斯瓦特佩克的 Pemex 石油储存设施发生一系列爆炸，引发大火，造成约 500 人死亡。

en: Iran hostage crisis: Iranian leader Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini orders the release of 13 female and black American hostages being held at the US Embassy in Tehran.
zh: 伊朗人质危机：伊朗领导人霍梅尼下令释放被扣押在美国驻德黑兰大使馆的 13 名女性和黑人美国人质。

en: TAP Air Portugal Flight 425 crashes in the Madeira Islands, killing 131.
zh: TAP 葡萄牙航空 425 号航班在马德拉群岛坠毁，造成 131 人死亡。

en: Egyptian President Anwar Sadat adresses the knesset during his visit to Jerusalem, calling for peace between Egypt and Israel.
zh: 埃及总统安瓦尔·萨达特在访问耶路撒冷期间向议会发表讲话，呼吁埃及和以色列实现和平。

en: Apollo program: Apollo 12 astronauts Pete Conrad and Alan Bean land at Oceanus Procellarum (the "Ocean of Storms") and become the third and fourth humans to walk on the Moon.
zh: 阿波罗计划：阿波罗 12 号宇航员皮特·康拉德和艾伦·比恩登陆 Oceanus Procellarum（“风暴之海”），成为第三和第四位登上月球的人类。

en: Association football player Pelé scores his 1,000th goal.
zh: 足球运动员贝利打进了他的第 1000 个进球。

en: The establishment of TVB, the first wireless commercial television station in Hong Kong.
zh: 香港第一家无线商业电视台TVB成立。

en: Télé Monte Carlo, Europe's oldest private television channel, is launched by Prince Rainier III.
zh: Télé Monte Carlo 是欧洲最古老的私人电视频道，由雷尼尔三世亲王创办。

en: Greek Field Marshal Alexander Papagos becomes the 152nd Prime Minister of Greece.
zh: 希腊陆军元帅亚历山大·帕帕戈斯就任希腊第 152 任总理。

en: US General Dwight D. Eisenhower becomes Supreme Commander of NATO-Europe.
zh: 美国将军德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔成为北约欧洲最高指挥官。

en: Afghanistan, Iceland and Sweden join the United Nations.
zh: 阿富汗、冰岛和瑞典加入联合国。

en: World War II: U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt announces the sixth War Loan Drive, aimed at selling US$14 billion in war bonds to help pay for the war effort.
zh: 第二次世界大战：美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福宣布第六次战争贷款计划，旨在出售 140 亿美元的战争债券，以帮助支付战争费用。

en: World War II: Thirty members of the Luxembourgish resistance defend the town of Vianden against a larger Waffen-SS attack in the Battle of Vianden.
zh: 第二次世界大战：在维安登战役中，三十名卢森堡抵抗运动成员保卫维安登镇，抵御党卫军更大规模的攻击。

en: The founding congress of the Communist Party of Transcarpathian Ukraine is held in Mukachevo.
zh: 外喀尔巴阡乌克兰共产党成立大会在穆卡切沃举行。

en: The Holocaust: Nazis liquidate Janowska concentration camp in Lemberg (Lviv), western Ukraine, murdering at least 6,000 Jews after a failed uprising and mass escape attempt.
zh: 大屠杀：纳粹清理了乌克兰西部伦贝格（利沃夫）的亚诺夫斯卡集中营，在一次失败的起义和大规模逃亡企图后杀害了至少 6,000 名犹太人。

en: World War II: Battle of Stalingrad: Soviet Union forces under General Georgy Zhukov launch the Operation Uranus counterattacks at Stalingrad, turning the tide of the battle in the USSR's favor.
Mutesa II is crowned the 35th and last Kabaka (king) of Buganda, prior to the restoration of the kingdom in 1993.
Samuel Goldwyn and Edgar Selwyn establish Goldwyn Pictures.
First Balkan War: The Serbian Army captures Bitola, ending the five-century-long Ottoman rule of Macedonia.
The Doom Bar in Cornwall claims two ships, Island Maid and Angele, the latter killing the entire crew except the captain.
Serbo-Bulgarian War: Bulgarian victory in the Battle of Slivnitsa solidifies the unification between the Principality of Bulgaria and Eastern Rumelia.
A meteorite lands near the village of Grossliebenthal, southwest of Odesa, Ukraine.
American Civil War: U.S. President Abraham Lincoln delivers the Gettysburg Address at the dedication ceremony for the military cemetery at Gettysburg, Pennsylvania.
The second Canadian railway line, the Montreal and Lachine Railroad, is opened.
Finnish War: The Convention of Olkijoki in Raahe ends hostilities in Finland.
The Garinagu arrive at British Honduras (present-day Belize).
The United States and the Kingdom of Great Britain sign Jay's Treaty, which attempts to resolve some of the lingering problems left over from the American Revolutionary War.
The current Saint Peter's Basilica is consecrated in Rome, replacing an earlier basilica on the same site.
Coronation of John V Palaiologos as Byzantine Emperor during the Byzantine civil war of 1341–1347.
The Rashidun Caliphate defeats the Sasanian Empire at the Battle of al-Qādisiyyah in Iraq.
Libius Severus is declared emperor of the Western Roman Empire. The real power is in the hands of the magister militum Ricimer.
Success on the outside means nothing unless you also have success within.
Anthropic is the first purely AI company to be publicly listed, creating a test for the entire industry.
Orla Guerin speaks to seven people trapped in Taiz by the Houthis who reveal what life is like under siege.
The unprecedented International Court of Justice verdict concerns a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands.
European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.
While the presidents have previously met for one-on-one meetings, this is their first trilateral discussion.
The probe by California, where the AI chipmaker has its global headquarters, follows former CEO Jensen Huang's departure.
Fiona, who became an internet star after her premature birth in 2017, "fought until she couldn’t anymore", the zoo says.
Markle, who has denied possessing images of child sex abuse was deemed competent after an evaluation by a court-appointed psychiatrist.
Rose, who died in 2024, was given a lifetime ban from the sport for betting on games but was reinstated last year.
At least four bodies have been recovered from the boat which was reportedly carrying between 50 and 100 people.
The bridge - a symbol of Russia's occupation of the Crimean Peninsula - suffered major damaged following a combined attack by Ukraine earlier this week.
The US Secretary of Defence says Venezuela has "gone from our most aggressive regional threat to a compliant security partner".
At a hearing on the possibility of parole, Smith said she wished she could change the past, and her two children "did not deserve to die".
The Mrima Hill site is estimated to hold deposits of critical minerals worth more than $60bn (£45bn).
Survivors reject relocation plans they say ignore their safety, land rights and livelihoods.
Christian Emmanuel Sanon is convicted of involvement in the plot that resulted in the killing of Jovenel Moïse.
Hamas condemned the incursion, which the Israeli military said was to dismantle a "terror tunnel", as a "flagrant" ceasefire violation.
The BBC's Samira Hussain breaks down the AI company's first day as a publicly traded company, as shares closed up 17%.
The beloved hippopotamus died days after swallowing a knitted hat that accidentally got into her enclosure at the Cincinnati Zoo.
The verdict marks the first time a state has ever been found to have committed genocide by an international court.
Trump, Putin and Xi have issued a "joint declaration of peace" after historical trilateral talks, but what did they get out of meeting?
A truck driver's fortunes have changed overnight after he won a Diwali lottery in the northern Indian state of Punjab.
Cumin-laced sodas are capturing a bigger market share in India as demand for homegrown flavours goes up.
African countries at the UN climate summit in Turkey are demanding more funding from developed nations to help them cope with climate change.
Shark Tank's Kevin O'Leary is among the big investors looking to Canada as a data centre development destination, while his US project faces local opposition.
DJ lag, one of South Africa's best-known electronic music producers, is among several African stars to feature on Grand Theft Auto 6.
The 2022 FIFA World Cup begins in Qatar. This is the first time the tournament was held in the Middle East.
Jimmie Johnson wins his seventh NASCAR Cup Series championship to tie Richard Petty and Dale Earnhardt for the most all-time.
Following a hostage siege, at least 19 people are killed in Bamako, Mali.
After the November 15 bombings, a second day of the 2003 Istanbul bombings occurs in Istanbul, Turkey, destroying the Turkish head office of HSBC Bank AS and the British consulate.
A court in Taliban-controlled Afghanistan declares accused terrorist Osama bin Laden "a man without a sin" in regard to the 1998 U.S. embassy bombings in Kenya and Tanzania.
The first space station module component, Zarya, for the International Space Station is launched from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan.
A fire breaks out in an office building in Hong Kong, killing 41 people and injuring 81.
The Angolan government and UNITA rebels sign the Lusaka Protocol in Zambia, ending 19 years of civil war. (Localized fighting resumes the next year.)
Savings and loan crisis: The United States Senate Ethics Committee issues a stern censure of California senator Alan Cranston for his "dealings" with savings-and-loan executive Charles Keating.
North Macedonia's deadliest aviation disaster occurs when Avioimpex Flight 110, a Yakovlev Yak-42, crashes near Ohrid Airport, killing all 116 people on board.
In England, a fire breaks out in Windsor Castle, badly damaging the castle and causing over £50 million worth of damage.

An Azerbaijani MI-8 helicopter carrying 19 peacekeeping mission team with officials and journalists from Russia, Kazakhstan and Azerbaijan is shot down by Armenian military forces in Khojavend District of Azerbaijan.
Andrei Chikatilo, one of the Soviet Union's most prolific serial killers, is arrested; he eventually confesses to 56 killings.
Velvet Revolution: The number of protesters assembled in Prague, Czechoslovakia, swells from 200,000 the day before to an estimated half-million.
Microsoft Windows 1.0, the first graphical personal computer operating environment developed by Microsoft, is released.
The United States Department of Justice files its final anti-trust suit against AT&T Corporation. This suit later leads to the breakup of AT&T and its Bell System.
Vietnam War: The Plain Dealer (Cleveland, Ohio) publishes explicit photographs of dead villagers from the My Lai Massacre in Vietnam.
Occupation of Alcatraz: Native American activists seize control of Alcatraz Island until being ousted by the U.S. Government on June 11, 1971.
A total of 78 miners are killed in an explosion at the Consolidated Coal Company's No. 9 mine in Farmington, West Virginia in the Farmington Mine disaster.
Cuban Missile Crisis ends: In response to the Soviet Union agreeing to remove its missiles from Cuba, U.S. President John F. Kennedy ends the quarantine of the Caribbean nation.
The Declaration of the Rights of the Child is adopted by the United Nations.
The Princess Elizabeth (the future Queen) marries Lieutenant Philip Mountbatten, who becomes the Duke of Edinburgh, at Westminster Abbey in London.
Indonesian National Revolution: 96 Indonesian including I Gusti Ngurah Rai were killed during the Battle of Margarana with Dutch forces.
Nuremberg trials: Trials against 24 Nazi war criminals start at the Palace of Justice at Nuremberg.
World War II: Hungary becomes a signatory of the Tripartite Pact, officially joining the Axis powers.
José Antonio Primo de Rivera, founder of the Falange, is killed by a republican execution squad.
World War I: Battle of Cambrai begins: British forces make early progress in an attack on German positions but are later pushed back.
Garnier Expedition: French forces under Lieutenant Francis Garnier captured Hanoi from the Vietnamese.
American Civil War: A secession ordinance is filed by Kentucky's Confederate government.
Anglo-French blockade of the Río de la Plata: Battle of Vuelta de Obligado.
New Jersey becomes the first U.S. state to ratify the Bill of Rights.
American Revolutionary War: British forces land at the Palisades and then attack Fort Lee. The Continental Army starts to retreat across New Jersey.
The British fleet under Edward Hawke defeats a French fleet under Hubert de Brienne in the battle of Quiberon Bay, thus diminishing the chances for a French invasion of Britain.
Start of the Battle of Porto Bello between British and Spanish forces during the War of Jenkins' Ear.
Begin of the Russo-Turkish War of 1710–1713, after tensions between the two states escalate as the Ottomans provide shelter to King Charles XII of Sweden in their fortress of Bender.
Zumbi, the last of the leaders of Quilombo dos Palmares in early Brazil, is executed by the forces of Portuguese bandeirante Domingos Jorge Velho.
The Peace of Cremona ends the war between the Republic of Venice and the Duchy of Milan, after the victorious Venetian enterprise of military engineering of the Galeas per montes.
John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy, and Louis of Valois, Duke of Orléans, agree to a truce, but Burgundy would kill Orléans three days later.
Edward I becomes king of England following the death of his father Henry III of England.
Palermo is conquered by Henry VI, Holy Roman Emperor.
During the An Shi Rebellion, the Tang dynasty, with the help of Huihe tribe, recaptures Luoyang from the rebels.
Pressures weighed on US markets, with the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average pushed into correction territory.
zh: 美国市场承压，标准普尔500指数和道琼斯工业平均指数进入回调区间。

en: The UK-EU deal agreed on Friday covers British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme.
zh: 周五达成的英国-欧盟协议涵盖英国的食品出口、排放权交易和青年交流计划。

en: Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw described the incident as a "provocation" from Moscow.
zh: 无人受伤，也未有财产损失的报告，但华沙将该事件描述为莫斯科的“挑衅”。

en: The court has upheld the 2020 beating of the black music producer as an aggravated circumstance of racism.
zh: 法院认定2020年对黑人音乐制作人的殴打行为属于种族主义加重情节。

en: A mathematician at Anthropic says he used an AI to prove the famed Riemann hypothesis, though verification will take some time.
zh: Anthropic的一位数学家表示，他使用人工智能证明了著名的黎曼猜想，但验证还需要一些时间。

en: A judicial investigation was launched after a complaint was filed last year over "allegations of a sexual nature".
zh: 去年，在有人就“性侵指控”提出投诉后，司法调查随即启动。

en: Russia launched one of its biggest air attacks yet as it rejected the prospect of security guarantees for Ukraine.
zh: 俄罗斯发动了迄今为止最大规模的空袭之一，同时拒绝为乌克兰提供安全保障。

en: Plans to shutter the troubled facility date back to 2019, when the city council first voted to close it but delays arose over where to place inmates.
zh: 关闭这座问题重重的监狱的计划可追溯到2019年，当时市议会首次投票决定关闭该监狱，但由于对囚犯的安置地点存在分歧而导致计划延迟。

en: The Russian embassy in Denmark has denied the allegation, which has led to Russia's defence attaché being expelled.
zh: 俄罗斯驻丹麦大使馆否认了这一指控，该指控导致俄罗斯国防武官被驱逐。

en: The US president provided little detail on the potential policy, saying others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.
zh: 美国总统没有提供有关该潜在政策的太多细节，并表示他的团队中其他人也是第一次听说此事。

en: Nikhil Gupta pleaded guilty to murder-for-hire, conspiracy to commit murder-for-hire, and conspiracy to commit money laundering in February.
zh: 尼希尔·古普塔于2月对雇凶杀人、共谋雇凶杀人和共谋洗钱表示认罪。

en: Police officials called for "greater efforts to prevent...
zh: 警方官员呼吁“加大力度防止……

en: This prolonged execution comes weeks after Christa Pike survived the lethal injection of the same drug.
zh: 在克里斯塔·派克（Christa Pike）在注射同一种药物后幸存数周后，这次处决被延长。

en: Carys Douglas, 23, made her stage debut this year in Anton Chekhov's play, The Seagull, in the US.
zh: 23岁的卡莉丝·道格拉斯（Carys Douglas）今年在美国首次登台演出安东·契诃夫（Anton Chekhov）的戏剧《海鸥》（The Seagull）。

en: The students were caught with banned smart devices while taking the high-stakes Suneung exam.
zh: 学生们在参加高风险的“高考”时被发现携带违禁智能设备。

en: The Pentagon has released an eighth tranche of UFO records, which includes three video clips recorded in 2020, 2023 and 2026.
zh: 五角大楼发布了第八批UFO记录，其中包括2020年、2023年和2026年录制的三个视频片段。

en: The BBC's political and Europe editors analyse the new agreements between the UK and EU.
zh: 英国广播公司的政治和欧洲事务编辑分析了英国与欧盟之间的新协议。

en: Thousands marched across European cities on Friday to protest against the cost of living and other issues.
zh: 周五，成千上万人走上欧洲各城市的街头，抗议生活成本和其他问题。

en: Russia struck bridges and railway stations in the capital Kyiv in a major attack.
zh: 俄罗斯发动大规模袭击，轰炸了首都基辅的桥梁和火车站。

en: How convicted fraudsters made millions from detained immigrants, evaded efforts to shut down their bail business and left migrants behind bars.
zh: 被定罪的诈骗犯如何从被拘留的移民身上赚取数百万美元，如何逃避关闭其保释业务的努力，以及如何让移民身陷囹圄。

en: The ANC appears reluctant to replicate its national power-sharing deal with the pro-business DA at the local level.
zh: 非洲人国民大会似乎不愿意在地方层面效仿其与亲商的民主联盟达成的国家权力分享协议。

en: Grieving Filipinos confront a distressing reality: their dogs and cats may not have received the send-off they paid for.
zh: 悲痛的菲律宾人正面临着一个令人痛心的现实：他们为爱犬和爱猫支付了安葬费用，但这些宠物可能并没有得到应有的送别。

en: Trade, connectivity and regional cooperation will be on top of the agenda when Nepal's PM meets his India counterpart.
zh: 尼泊尔总理与印度总理会晤时，贸易、互联互通和区域合作将成为议程的重中之重。

en: Orla Guerin speaks to seven people trapped in the key city of Taiz, cut off from the outside world for weeks.
zh: 奥拉·格林（Orla Guerin）采访了被困在重要城市塔伊兹的七个人，他们已与外界隔绝数周。

en: A magnitude 5.6 earthquake on the Indonesian island of Java kills between 335 and 602 people.
zh: 印度尼西亚爪哇岛发生 5.6 级地震，造成 335 至 602 人死亡。

en: An SUV plows through a Christmas parade in Waukesha, Wisconsin, killing six and injuring 62.
zh: 一辆SUV冲入威斯康星州沃基肖市的圣诞游行队伍，造成6人死亡，62人受伤。

en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is indicted on charges of bribery, fraud, and breach of trust.
zh: 以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡被控犯有贿赂、欺诈和违反诚信罪。

en: Tesla launches the SUV Cybertruck. A gaffe occurs during the launch event when its "unbreakable" windows shatter during demonstration.
zh: 特斯拉推出SUV车型Cybertruck。在发布会上，当“坚不可摧”的车窗在演示过程中破碎时，出现了一次失误。

en: Robert Mugabe formally resigns as President of Zimbabwe, after thirty-seven years in office.
zh: 罗伯特·穆加贝在执政三十七年后正式辞去津巴布韦总统职务。

en: The government of Belgium imposes a security lockdown on Brussels, including the closure of shops, schools, and public transportation, due to potential terrorist attacks.
zh: 由于潜在的恐怖袭击，比利时政府对布鲁塞尔实施安全封锁，包括关闭商店、学校和公共交通。

en: A stampede in Kwekwe, Zimbabwe caused by the police firing tear gas kills at least eleven people and injures 40 others.
zh: 津巴布韦克韦克韦发生踩踏事件，原因是警察发射催泪瓦斯，造成至少 11 人死亡，40 人受伤。

en: Fifty-four people are killed when the roof of a shopping center collapses in Riga, Latvia.
zh: 拉脱维亚里加一家购物中心的屋顶坍塌，造成 54 人死亡。

en: Massive protests start in Ukraine after President Viktor Yanukovych suspended signing the Ukraine–European Union Association Agreement.
zh: 在总统维克托·亚努科维奇暂停签署《乌克兰-欧盟联系国协定》后，乌克兰爆发大规模抗议活动。

en: At least 28 are wounded after a bomb is thrown onto a bus in Tel Aviv.
zh: 特拉维夫一辆巴士被投掷炸弹，造成至少28人受伤。

en: A mine explosion in Heilongjiang, China kills 108.
zh: 中国黑龙江省发生矿井爆炸，造成 108 人死亡。

en: Anti-Syrian Lebanese politician and government minister Pierre Gemayel is assassinated in suburban Beirut.
zh: 反叙利亚的黎巴嫩政治家兼政府部长皮埃尔·杰马耶勒在贝鲁特郊区遇刺身亡。

en: The second round of the Ukrainian presidential election is held, giving rise to massive protests and controversy over the election's integrity.
zh: 乌克兰总统选举第二轮投票举行，引发大规模抗议活动以及对选举公正性的争议。

en: The Paris Club agrees to write off 80% (up to $100 billion) of Iraq's external debt.
zh: 巴黎俱乐部同意免除伊拉克80%的外债（最高1000亿美元）。

en: China Eastern Airlines Flight 5210 crashes after takeoff from Baotou Donghe Airport, killing 55.
zh: 中国东方航空公司5210航班在从包头东河机场起飞后坠毁，造成55人死亡。

en: NATO invites Bulgaria, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Romania, Slovakia and Slovenia to become members.
zh: 北约邀请保加利亚、爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚、立陶宛、罗马尼亚、斯洛伐克和斯洛文尼亚加入。

en: Arturo Guzmán Decena, founder of Los Zetas and high-member of the Gulf Cartel, is killed in a shoot-out with the Mexican Army and the police.
zh: 洛斯·塞塔斯 (Los Zetas) 的创始人兼海湾卡特尔 (Gulf Cartel) 的高级成员阿图罗·古兹曼·德塞纳 (Arturo Guzmán Decena) 在与墨西哥军队和警察的交火中丧生。

en: Finnish satanist Jarno Elg kills a 23-year-old man and performs a ritual-like cutting and eating of body parts in Hyvinkää, Finland.
zh: 芬兰撒旦教徒Jarno Elg在芬兰许于凯莱杀害一名23岁男子，并以仪式般的方式肢解并食用其身体部位。

en: Humberto Vidal explosion: Thirty-three people die when a Humberto Vidal shoe shop in Río Piedras, Puerto Rico explodes.
zh: 翁贝托·比达尔爆炸案：波多黎各里奥皮德拉斯的一家翁贝托·比达尔鞋店发生爆炸，造成 33 人死亡。

en: The Dayton Agreement is initialed at the Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, near Dayton, Ohio, ending three and a half years of war in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
zh: 《代顿和平协定》在俄亥俄州代顿附近的赖特-帕特森空军基地签署，结束了波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那长达三年半的战争。

en: Bangkok Airways Flight 125 crashes on approach to Samui Airport, killing 38.
zh: 曼谷航空公司 125 号航班在降落苏梅机场时坠毁，造成 38 人死亡。

en: Aeroflot Flight 37577 crashes on approach to Sovetsky Airport, killing 32.
zh: 俄罗斯国际航空公司 37577 航班在接近索韦茨基机场时坠毁，造成 32 人死亡。

en: National Security Council member Oliver North and his secretary start to shred documents allegedly implicating them in the Iran–Contra affair.
zh: 国家安全委员会成员奥利弗·诺思（Oliver North）及其秘书开始销毁据称涉及他们伊朗-孔特拉事件的文件。

en: United States Navy intelligence analyst Jonathan Pollard is arrested for spying after being caught giving Israel classified information on Arab nations. He is subsequently sentenced to life in prison.
zh: 美国海军情报分析员乔纳森·波拉德（Jonathan Pollard）因向以色列提供有关阿拉伯国家的机密信息而被捕，罪名是从事间谍活动。他随后被判处无期徒刑。

en: The United States Embassy in Islamabad, Pakistan, is attacked by a mob and set on fire, killing four.
zh: 位于巴基斯坦伊斯兰堡的美国大使馆遭到暴徒袭击并被纵火，造成四人死亡。

en: Minister of Internal Affairs Allan Highet announces that the national anthems of New Zealand shall be the traditional anthem "God Save the Queen" and "God Defend New Zealand".
zh: 内政部长艾伦·海格特（Allan Highet）宣布，新西兰的国歌将是传统国歌《天佑吾皇》（God Save the Queen）和《天佑新西兰》（God Defend New Zealand）。

en: The Birmingham pub bombings kill 21 people. The Birmingham Six are sentenced to life in prison for the crime but are later exonerated.
zh: 伯明翰酒吧爆炸案造成21人死亡。“伯明翰六人组”因该罪行被判处无期徒刑，但后来被宣告无罪。

en: Voters in South Korea overwhelmingly approve a new constitution, giving legitimacy to Park Chung Hee and the Fourth Republic.
zh: 韩国选民以压倒性多数批准新宪法，使朴正熙和第四共和国获得合法性。

en: Indian troops, partly aided by Mukti Bahini (Bengali guerrillas), defeat the Pakistan army in the Battle of Garibpur.
zh: 印度军队在孟加拉游击队“ मुक्ति军”的部分协助下，在加里布尔战役中击败了巴基斯坦军队。

en: The first permanent ARPANET link is established between UCLA and SRI.
zh: 第一条永久性 ARPANET 链路在加州大学洛杉矶分校和斯坦福研究院之间建立。

en: Vietnam War: American General William Westmoreland tells news reporters: "I am absolutely certain that whereas in 1965 the enemy was winning, today he is certainly losing."
zh: 越南战争：美国将军威廉·威斯特摩兰 (William Westmoreland) 对记者说：“我绝对确信，虽然在 1965 年敌人占了上风，但今天他们肯定会败下阵来。”

en: The Verrazzano–Narrows Bridge opens to traffic. At the time it is the world's longest bridge span.
zh: 韦拉扎诺海峡大桥通车。当时，它是世界上最长的桥梁跨度。

en: Second Vatican Council: The third session of the Roman Catholic Church's ecumenical council closes.
zh: 梵蒂冈第二届大公会议：罗马天主教教会的第三次大公会议闭幕。

en: The Chinese People's Liberation Army declares a unilateral ceasefire in the Sino-Indian War.
zh: 中国人民解放军宣布在中印战争中单方面停火。

en: "La Ronde" opens in Honolulu, the first revolving restaurant in the United States.
zh: “La Ronde”在檀香山开业，这是美国第一家旋转餐厅。

en: People's Action Party, an eventual dominative political party in Singapore, was established.
zh: 新加坡最终的执政党人民行动党成立。

en: The Natural History Museum, London announces that the "Piltdown Man" skull, initially believed to be one of the most important fossilized hominid skulls ever found, is a hoax.
Two Canadian National Railway trains collide in northeastern British Columbia in the Canoe River train crash; the death toll is 21, with 17 of them Canadian troops bound for Korea.
The United Auto Workers strike 92 General Motors plants in 50 cities to back up worker demands for a 30-percent raise.
World War II: American submarine USS Sealion sinks the Japanese battleship Kongō and Japanese destroyer Urakaze in the Formosa Strait.
The completion of the Alaska Highway (also known as the Alcan Highway) is celebrated (however, the highway is not usable by standard road vehicles until 1943).
Columbine Mine massacre: Striking coal miners are allegedly attacked with machine guns by a detachment of Colorado state police dressed in civilian clothes.
Rebecca Latimer Felton of Georgia takes the oath of office, becoming the first female United States Senator.
The Flag of Estonia, previously used by pro-independence activists, is formally adopted as the national flag of the Republic of Estonia.
The Parliament (Qualification of Women) Act 1918 is passed, allowing women to stand for Parliament in the UK.
A pogrom takes place in Lwów (now Lviv); over three days, at least 50 Jews and 270 Ukrainian Christians are killed by Poles.
World War I: One of the mines laid by SM U-73 sink HMHS Britannic in the Kea Channel, the largest ship lost in the war.
Sailors on board Brazil's warships including the Minas Gerais, São Paulo, and Bahia, violently rebel in what is now known as the Revolta da Chibata (Revolt of the Lash).
Albert Einstein's paper that leads to the mass–energy equivalence formula, E = mc², is published in the journal Annalen der Physik.
The Philadelphia Football Athletics defeat the Kanaweola Athletic Club of Elmira, New York, 39–0, in the first-ever professional American football night game.
Claude Monet's paintings shown at Gallery Durand-Ruel in Paris.
Port Arthur, China, falls to the Japanese, a decisive victory of the First Sino-Japanese War; Japanese troops are accused of massacring the remaining inhabitants.
Thomas Edison announces his invention of the phonograph, a machine that can record and play sound.
American Civil War: Confederate President Jefferson Davis appoints Judah Benjamin Secretary of War.
Mutineers take control of the Chilean penal colony of Punta Arenas in the Strait of Magellan.
North Carolina ratifies the United States Constitution and is admitted as the 12th U.S. state.
In Paris, Jean-François Pilâtre de Rozier and François Laurent d'Arlandes make the first untethered hot air balloon flight.
The fortress of Portobello, Panama, surrenders to a Royal Navy squadron under Edward Vernon during the War of Jenkins' Ear.
The Danish astronomer Ole Rømer presents the first quantitative measurements of the speed of light.
Plymouth Colony settlers sign the Mayflower Compact (November 11, O.S.)
Timur of Samarkand captures and sacks the Georgian capital of Tbilisi, taking King Bagrat V of Georgia captive.
Pope Anterus succeeds Pontian as the nineteenth pope.
A single dream is more powerful than a thousand realities.
Ukraine's president says Kyiv acted after 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on bridges in Ukraine.
zh: 乌克兰总统表示，基辅在俄罗斯对乌克兰桥梁进行 109 次空袭后采取了行动。

en: Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone attack on the vessel.
zh: 芬兰国防军表示，乌克兰很可能是无人机袭击该船的幕后黑手。

en: Countries from nearly 200 countries are in a deadlock to try and get a new global climate agreement.
zh: 来自近 200 个国家的国家在试图达成新的全球气候协议方面陷入僵局。

en: Fausto Isidro "Chapo Idisro" Meza Flores, who is accused of drug trafficking and torture, is detained after gun fight with authorities.
zh: 福斯托·伊西德罗·“矮子·伊迪斯罗”·梅萨·弗洛雷斯 (Fausto Isidro "Chapo Idisro" Meza Flores) 被指控贩毒和酷刑，在与当局发生枪战后被拘留。

en: The National Crime Information Center database is used by federal and local law enforcement to share information.
zh: 联邦和地方执法部门使用国家犯罪信息中心数据库来共享信息。

en: The 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson leading to wildfires that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.
zh: 这名 30 岁的洛杉矶居民被判犯有导致山火纵火罪，这场山火导致 12 人死亡并摧毁了 6,800 多座建筑物。

en: The hair was given as a sign of friendship shortly before Washington's death in 1799, according to a descendent of its former owner.
zh: 据这头头发前主人的后裔称，这头头发是在 1799 年华盛顿去世前不久赠送的，作为友谊的象征。

en: Brussels sources had previously suggested the bloc might not apply the wider deal until fees were lowered for EU students in Britain.
zh: 布鲁塞尔消息人士此前曾暗示，在降低英国欧盟学生的学费之前，欧盟可能不会实施更广泛的协议。

en: The 21m tree is Oslo’s annual thank you for Britain’s support during World War Two.
zh: 这棵 21m 的树是奥斯陆每年一度的感谢英国在第二次世界大战期间提供的支持。

en: Earlier this week, Trump greeted Putin ahead of a meeting in China and said the pair have a "great relationship".
zh: 本周早些时候，特朗普在中国会晤之前向普京致意，并表示两人有着“良好的关系”。

en: BBC News Mundo’s Rafael Rojas visits the real-life Miami locations that inspired Vice City, GTA 6’s fictionalised setting.
zh: BBC News Mundo 的拉斐尔·罗哈斯 (Rafael Rojas) 探访了现实生活中的迈阿密地点，这些地点为《侠盗猎车手 6》的虚构场景《罪恶都市》提供了灵感。

en: When 16-year-old Landon Tresp met a teenage girl in an online game, it led to him and his mother helping the FBI rescue her from kidnapping.
zh: 当 16 岁的兰登·特雷普 (Landon Tresp) 在一款网络游戏中遇到一名十几岁的女孩时，他和他的母亲帮助联邦调查局 (FBI) 将她从绑架中解救出来。

en: Fewer young people have registered to vote in next year's election than in 2023 - are young people losing faith in democracy?
zh: 登记参加明年选举投票的年轻人比 2023 年要少——年轻人是否对民主失去了信心？

en: A shooting at a Walmart in Chesapeake, Virginia leaves seven workers dead, including the shooter, and four others injured.
zh: 弗吉尼亚州切萨皮克市一家沃尔玛发生枪击事件，造成包括枪手在内的七名工人死亡，另有四人受伤。

en: While playing with a toy gun in Cleveland, 12-year-old African American Tamir Rice is killed by a white police officer.
zh: 12 岁非裔美国人塔米尔·赖斯 (Tamir Rice) 在克利夫兰玩玩具枪时被一名白人警察杀害。

en: During the Cambodian water festival, a stampede in Koh Pich, Phnom Penh, kills 347 people.
zh: 柬埔寨泼水节期间，金边Koh Pich发生踩踏事件，造成347人死亡。

en: The Orange Revolution begins in Ukraine, resulting from the presidential elections.
zh: 乌克兰因总统选举而爆发橙色革命。

en: Baghdad DHL attempted shootdown incident: Shortly after takeoff, a DHL Express cargo plane is struck on the left wing by a surface-to-air missile and forced to land.
zh: 巴格达 DHL 未遂击落事件：起飞后不久，一架 DHL Express 货机左翼被地对空导弹击中，被迫降落。

en: British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher withdraws from the Conservative Party leadership election, confirming the end of her Premiership.
zh: 英国首相玛格丽特·撒切尔退出保守党领袖选举，确认其首相任期结束。

en: NASA launches Space Shuttle Discovery on STS-33, a classified mission for the United States Department of Defense.
zh: NASA 在 STS-33 上发射发现号航天飞机，这是美国国防部的一项机密任务。

en: The Max Headroom signal hijacking incident takes place, in which a pirate broadcast interrupts television broadcasts in Chicago.
zh: 发生了最大净空信号劫持事件，盗版广播中断了芝加哥的电视广播。

en: Juan Carlos is declared King of Spain following the death of Francisco Franco two days earlier.
zh: 两天前弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥去世后，胡安·卡洛斯被宣布为西班牙国王。

en: In Britain's worst mountaineering tragedy, the Cairngorm Plateau Disaster, five children and one of their leaders are found dead from exposure in the Scottish mountains.
zh: 在英国最严重的登山悲剧“凯恩戈姆高原灾难”中，五名儿童和一名领导人被发现在苏格兰山区暴露死亡。

en: Japan Air Lines Flight 2 accidentally ditches in San Francisco Bay while on approach to San Francisco International Airport. No one is injured.
zh: 日本航空 2 号航班在飞往旧金山国际机场时意外迫降在旧金山湾。没有人受伤。

en: UN Security Council Resolution 242 is adopted, establishing a set of the principles aimed at guiding negotiations for an Arab–Israeli peace settlement.
zh: 联合国安理会第 242 号决议获得通过，确立了一套旨在指导阿以和平解决谈判的原则。

en: Five Indian generals are killed in a helicopter crash, due to collision with two parallel lines of telegraph cables.
zh: 五名印度将军在一次直升机坠毁事故中丧生，原因是与两条平行的电报电缆相撞。

en: The Soviet Union launches RDS-37, a 1.6 megaton two stage hydrogen bomb designed by Andrei Sakharov. The bomb was dropped over Semipalatinsk.
zh: 苏联发射了 RDS-37，这是由安德烈·萨哈罗夫设计的 1.6 兆吨两级氢弹。炸弹被投在塞米巴拉金斯克上空。

en: A Douglas C-124 Globemaster II crashes into Mount Gannet, Alaska, killing all 52 aboard.
zh: 一架道格拉斯 C-124 环球霸王 II 坠毁在阿拉斯加的塘鹅山，机上 52 人全部遇难。

en: World War II: Cairo Conference: U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt, British Prime Minister Winston Churchill, and Chinese Premier Chiang Kai-shek meet in Cairo, Egypt, to discuss ways to defeat Japan.
zh: 第二次世界大战：开罗会议：美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福、英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔和中国总理蒋介石在埃及开罗举行会议，讨论击败日本的方法。

en: Lebanon gains independence from France, nearly two years after it was first announced by the Free French government.
zh: 自由法国政府首次宣布黎巴嫩脱离法国独立已近两年。

en: World War II: Battle of Stalingrad: General Friedrich Paulus sends Adolf Hitler a telegram saying that the German 6th Army is surrounded.
zh: 第二次世界大战：斯大林格勒战役：弗里德里希·保卢斯将军给阿道夫·希特勒发了一封电报，称德国第6集团军被包围。

en: World War II: Following the initial Italian invasion, Greek troops counterattack into Italian-occupied Albania and capture Korytsa.
zh: 第二次世界大战：意大利首次入侵后，希腊军队反击意大利占领的阿尔巴尼亚并占领科里察。

en: The China Clipper inaugurates the first commercial transpacific air service, connecting Alameda, California with Manila.
zh: 中国快船开辟了第一条商业跨太平洋航空​​服务，连接加利福尼亚州阿拉米达和马尼拉。

en: During The Troubles in Ulster (1920–1922), 15 Irish Nationalists are killed in Belfast in one day.
zh: 在阿尔斯特麻烦期间（1920-1922 年），一天之内就有 15 名爱尔兰民族主义者在贝尔法斯特被杀。

en: The Congress of Manastir establishes the Albanian alphabet.
zh: 马纳斯提尔议会制定了阿尔巴尼亚字母表。

en: The French steamer SS Ville du Havre sinks in 12 minutes after colliding with the Scottish iron clipper Loch Earn in the Atlantic, with a loss of 226 lives.
zh: 法国轮船SS Ville du Havre在大西洋与苏格兰铁快船Loch Earn相撞，12分钟后沉没，造成226人死亡。

en: In Dumbarton, Scotland, the clipper Cutty Sark is launched.
zh: 在苏格兰敦巴顿，快船卡蒂萨克号下水。

en: In Birmingham, England, Albert, Prince Consort lays the foundation stone of the Birmingham and Midland Institute.
zh: 在英国伯明翰，阿尔伯特亲王为伯明翰和米德兰学院奠基。

en: Canadian journalist and politician William Lyon Mackenzie calls for a rebellion against the United Kingdom in his essay "To the People of Upper Canada", published in his newspaper The Constitution.
zh: 加拿大记者兼政治家威廉·里昂·麦肯齐在他的报纸《宪法》上发表的文章《致上加拿大人民》中呼吁反抗英国。

en: Dutch colonial forces on Taiwan launch a pacification campaign against native villages, resulting in Dutch control of the middle and south of the island.
zh: 荷兰在台湾的殖民势力对当地村庄发动了平定运动，导致荷兰控制了台湾中部和南部。

en: Spanish navigator Juan Fernández discovers islands now known as the Juan Fernández Islands off Chile.
zh: 西班牙航海家胡安·费尔南德斯在智利附近发现了现在被称为胡安·费尔南德斯群岛的岛屿。

en: Pope Clement V issues the papal bull Pastoralis Praeeminentiae which instructed all Christian monarchs in Europe to arrest all Templars and seize their assets.
zh: 教皇克莱门特五世颁布了教皇训令《Pastoralis Praeeminentiae》，指示欧洲所有基督教君主逮捕所有圣殿骑士并没收他们的资产。

en: Frederick II is crowned Holy Roman Emperor in Rome by Pope Honorius III.
zh: 腓特烈二世在罗马由教皇霍诺留三世加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇帝。

en: The Castle of Termes falls to Simon de Montfort after a four-month siege during the Albigensian Crusade.
zh: 在阿尔比派十字军东征期间，经过四个月的围困后，泰尔梅斯城堡落入西蒙·德·蒙福特之手。

en: The first duke of Brittany, Nominoe, defeats the Frankish king Charles the Bald at the Battle of Ballon near Redon.
zh: 布列塔尼第一位公爵诺米诺在雷东附近的巴隆战役中击败了法兰克国王秃头查理。

en: Emperor Maurice loses control over Constantinople and flees the city.
zh: 莫里斯皇帝失去了对君士坦丁堡的控制并逃离了这座城市。

en: During the Three-Chapter Controversy, Pope Vigilius is abducted on order of emperor Justinian I in order to force him to agree with Byzantine imperial religious policy.
zh: 在三章之争期间，教皇维吉利乌斯被查士丁尼一世皇帝下令绑架，以迫使他同意拜占庭帝国的宗教政策。

en: After the death of Anastasius II, Symmachus is elected Pope in the Lateran Palace, while Laurentius is elected Pope in Santa Maria Maggiore.
zh: 阿纳斯塔修斯二世去世后，欣马库斯当选为拉特兰宫教皇，劳伦蒂斯当选为圣玛丽亚马焦雷教皇。

en: If you want to find the secrets of the universe, think in terms of energy, frequency and vibration.
zh: 如果你想找到宇宙的秘密，请从能量、频率和振动的角度来思考。

en: Hopes for an agreement on tackling climate change collapsed after a row about mentioning fossil fuels
zh: 在就提及化石燃料问题发生争执后，就应对气候变化达成协议的希望破灭了。

en: The talks have been the longest-running in the summit's history, with negotiations breaking down two days after they had been due to end.
zh: 此次会谈是峰会历史上持续时间最长的会谈，谈判在原定结束日期两天后破裂。

en: Libya's eastern government says the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.
zh: 利比亚东部政府表示，该船在返回俄罗斯的途中曾停靠补给燃料和物资。

en: The BBC's Sarah Rainsford reports from the scene of a collapsed residential building in Ukraine's Kyiv region.
zh: 英国广播公司（BBC）的莎拉·雷恩斯福德（Sarah Rainsford）从乌克兰基辅州一栋倒塌的住宅楼现场发回报道。

en: Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone strike on Saturday.
zh: 芬兰国防军表示，周六的无人机袭击很可能是乌克兰所为。

en: Choi Kyo-jin admits last-minute measures to stop AI-assisted cheating during the college entrance exam caused chaos.
zh: 崔教振承认，在高考期间为阻止借助人工智能作弊而采取的临时措施造成了混乱。

en: At least three people were killed and many more feared dead after a fire at a confectionary factory.
zh: 一家糖果厂发生火灾，至少有三人丧生，还有更多人恐怕已经遇难。

en: Democrats have now won at least 258 seats in the midterms compared to Republicans, who hold at least 173 seats.
zh: 民主党目前在中期选举中至少赢得了258个席位，而共和党至少获得了173个席位。

en: The Army says "swift action" is necessary to protect its personnel and nearby communities around its ammunition plant in Iowa.
zh: 陆军表示，必须采取“迅速行动”来保护其位于爱荷华州弹药厂的人员和周边社区。

en: The couple have been together for four years and were engaged in 2025.
zh: 这对情侣已经在一起四年了，并于2025年订婚。

en: In a statement to Italian media, his family remember him as "the greatest jeweller of our time".
zh: 在他的家人向意大利媒体发表的声明中，他们称其为“我们这个时代最伟大的珠宝商”。

en: The last Sumatran rhinoceros in Malaysia, Imam, dies, making the species officially extinct in the country.
zh: 马来西亚最后一头苏门答腊犀牛伊玛姆（Imam）死亡，该物种在该国正式灭绝。

en: Founders of Italian fashion brand Dolce & Gabbana issue an apology following a series of offensive advertisements on social media promoting a fashion show in Shanghai, China, which was canceled.
zh: 意大利时尚品牌杜嘉班纳（Dolce & Gabbana）的创始人就一系列在社交媒体上发布的冒犯性广告道歉，这些广告旨在宣传在中国上海举办的一场时装秀，但该时装秀已被取消。

en: Blue Origin's New Shepard space vehicle became the first rocket to successfully fly to space and then return to Earth for a controlled, vertical landing.
zh: 蓝色起源公司的New Shepard太空飞行器成为第一枚成功飞入太空，然后返回地球并以受控方式垂直着陆的火箭。

en: Arab Spring: After 11 months of protests in Yemen, Yemeni president Ali Abdullah Saleh signs a deal to transfer power to the vice president, in exchange for legal immunity.
zh: 阿拉伯之春：经过 11 个月的抗议活动，也门总统阿里·阿卜杜拉·萨利赫签署协议，将权力移交给副总统，以换取法律豁免。

en: Bombardment of Yeonpyeong: North Korean artillery attack kills two civilians and two marines on Yeonpyeong Island, South Korea.
zh: 延坪岛炮击事件：朝鲜炮击韩国延坪岛，造成两名平民和两名海军陆战队员死亡。

en: The Maguindanao massacre occurs in Ampatuan, Philippines; 58 opponents of Andal Ampatuan Jr. are kidnapped and killed.
zh: 马京达瑙大屠杀发生在菲律宾安帕图安；安达尔·安帕图安二世的 58 名反对者被绑架并杀害。

en: MS Explorer, a cruise liner carrying 154 people, sinks in the Antarctic Ocean south of Argentina after hitting an iceberg near the South Shetland Islands. There are no fatalities.
zh: 载有154人的邮轮“探险家号”在南设得兰群岛附近撞上冰山后，在阿根廷以南的南大洋沉没。无人员死亡。

en: Ellen Johnson Sirleaf is elected president of Liberia and becomes the first woman to lead an African country.
zh: 埃伦·约翰逊·瑟里夫当选利比里亚总统，成为首位领导非洲国家的女性。

en: The Holy Trinity Cathedral of Tbilisi, the largest religious building in Georgia, is consecrated.
zh: 格鲁吉亚最大的宗教建筑第比利斯圣三一主教座堂举行祝圣仪式。

en: Rose Revolution: Georgian president Eduard Shevardnadze resigns following weeks of mass protests over flawed elections.
zh: 玫瑰革命：在历时数周、针对选举舞弊的大规模抗议活动之后，格鲁吉亚总统爱德华·谢瓦尔德纳泽辞职。

en: Space Shuttle Endeavour launches on STS-113 to the International Space Station carrying the Expedition 6 crew and the P1 truss.
zh: “奋进号”航天飞机执行 STS-113 任务，搭载第 6 远征队宇航员和 P1 桁架飞往国际空间站。

en: The Budapest Convention on Cybercrime is signed in Budapest, Hungary.
zh: 《布达佩斯网络犯罪公约》在匈牙利布达佩斯签署。

en: Ethiopian Airlines Flight 961 is hijacked, then crashes into the Indian Ocean off the coast of Comoros after running out of fuel, killing 125.
zh: 埃塞俄比亚航空公司 961 号航班被劫持，随后因燃油耗尽而坠入科摩罗海岸附近的印度洋，造成 125 人死亡。

en: The first smartphone, the IBM Simon, is introduced at COMDEX in Las Vegas, Nevada.
zh: 第一款智能手机IBM Simon在内华达州拉斯维加斯的COMDEX上亮相。

en: Queen lead singer Freddie Mercury announces in a statement that he is HIV-positive. He dies the following day.
zh: 皇后乐队主唱弗雷迪·默丘里在一份声明中宣布自己是艾滋病毒阳性。他于次日去世。

en: Gunmen hijack EgyptAir Flight 648 en route from Athens to Cairo. When the plane lands in Malta, Egyptian commandos storm the aircraft, but 60 people die in the raid.
zh: 武装分子劫持了从雅典飞往开罗的埃及航空公司648号航班。飞机在马耳他降落后，埃及突击队突袭了飞机，但有60人在这次突袭中丧生。

en: Iran–Contra affair: Ronald Reagan signs the top secret National Security Decision Directive 17 (NSDD-17), giving the Central Intelligence Agency the authority to recruit and support Contra rebels in Nicaragua.
zh: 伊朗-康特拉事件：罗纳德·里根签署了绝密《国家安全决策指令17号》（NSDD-17），授权中央情报局招募和支持尼加拉瓜的康特拉叛军。

en: The 6.9 Mw Irpinia earthquake shakes southern Italy with a maximum Mercalli intensity of X (Extreme), killing 2,483–4,900, and injuring 7,700–8,934.
zh: 6.9 级伊尔皮尼亚地震袭击意大利南部，麦加利震级最高达到 X 级（极强），造成 2,483–4,900 人死亡，7,700–8,934 人受伤。

en: Cyclone kills about 1,000 people in eastern Sri Lanka.
zh: 气旋在斯里兰卡东部造成约 1,000 人死亡。

en: The Geneva Frequency Plan of 1975 goes into effect, realigning many of Europe's longwave and mediumwave broadcasting frequencies.
zh: 1975 年的《日内瓦频率计划》生效，重新调整了欧洲的许多长波和中波广播频率。

en: Jacques Mayol is the first man to reach a depth of 100 m (330 ft) undersea without breathing equipment.
zh: 雅克·马约尔是第一位在没有呼吸装备的情况下潜入 100 米（330 英尺）深度的潜水员。

en: Sixty Ethiopian politicians, aristocrats, military officers, and other persons are executed by the provisional military government.
zh: 60 名埃塞俄比亚政界人士、贵族、军官和其他人士被临时军政府处决。

en: The Soviet Union makes its final attempt at launching the N1 rocket.
zh: 苏联进行了最后一次N1火箭发射尝试。

en: Representatives of the People's Republic of China attend the United Nations, including the United Nations Security Council, for the first time.
zh: 中华人民共和国代表首次出席联合国会议，包括联合国安全理事会会议。

en: The first episode of Doctor Who ("An Unearthly Child") is broadcast by the BBC, which is now the world's longest running science fiction drama.
zh: 英国广播公司（BBC）播出了《神秘博士》（Doctor Who）的第一集《来自异世界的孩子》（An Unearthly Child），该剧现已成为世界上播映时间最长的科幻剧。

en: French President Charles de Gaulle declares in a speech in Strasbourg his vision for "Europe, from the Atlantic to the Urals".
zh: 法国总统戴高乐在斯特拉斯堡发表讲话，阐述了他对“从大西洋到乌拉尔山的欧洲”的愿景。

en: The Cocos Islands are transferred from the control of the United Kingdom to that of Australia.
zh: 科科斯群岛从英国的管辖下移交给澳大利亚。

en: French naval bombardment of Hai Phong, Vietnam, kills thousands of civilians.
zh: 法国海军轰炸越南海防，造成数千平民丧生。

en: World War II: The Lotta Svärd Movement is disbanded under the terms of the armistice treaty in Finland after the Continuation War.
zh: 第二次世界大战：根据《停战条约》的条款，洛塔·斯瓦德运动在芬兰的“续战”结束后解散。

en: World War II: The Deutsche Opernhaus on Bismarckstraße in the Berlin neighborhood of Charlottenburg is destroyed. It will eventually be rebuilt in 1961 and be called the Deutsche Oper Berlin.
zh: 第二次世界大战：位于柏林夏洛滕堡区俾斯麦大街的德国歌剧院被毁。剧院最终于1961年重建，并更名为柏林德国歌剧院。

en: World War II: Tarawa and Makin atolls fall to American forces.
zh: 第二次世界大战：塔拉瓦环礁和马金环礁落入美军之手。

en: World War II: The British passenger liner SS Tilawa is torpedoed and sunk by Japanese submarine I-29, with 280 passengers and crew killed out of 954 on board.
zh: 第二次世界大战：英国客轮“蒂拉瓦”号被日本潜艇I-29号鱼雷击中并击沉，船上954人中有280名乘客和船员遇难。

en: World War II: Romania becomes a signatory of the Tripartite Pact, officially joining the Axis powers.
zh: 第二次世界大战：罗马尼亚成为《三国同盟条约》的签署国，正式加入轴心国。

en: World War II: HMS Rawalpindi is sunk by the German battleships Scharnhorst and Gneisenau.
zh: 第二次世界大战：英国皇家海军“拉瓦尔品第”号巡洋舰被德国战列舰“沙恩霍斯特”号和“格奈森瑙”号击沉。

en: An Anglo-Ethiopian boundary commission in the Ogaden discovers an Italian garrison at Walwal, well within Ethiopian territory. This leads to the Abyssinia Crisis.
zh: 一个英埃边界委员会在欧加登发现意大利驻军位于瓦尔瓦尔，该地完全在埃塞俄比亚境内。这导致了阿比西尼亚危机。

en: Edwin Hubble's discovery, that the Andromeda "nebula" is actually another island galaxy far outside our own Milky Way, is first published in The New York Times.
zh: 埃德温·哈勃的发现——仙女座“星云”实际上是位于我们银河系之外的另一个岛状星系——首次发表在《纽约时报》上。

en: Thousands of Irish Republicans end the 1923 Irish hunger strikes, five die from starvation.
zh: 数千名爱尔兰共和主义者结束了 1923 年的爱尔兰绝食抗议，五人饿死。

en: Warren G. Harding, 29th President of the United States, signs the Willis–Campbell Act into law, prohibiting doctors from prescribing beer or liquor for medicinal purposes.
zh: 美国第29任总统沃伦·G·哈丁签署《威利斯-坎贝尔法案》，该法案禁止医生出于医疗目的开具啤酒或烈酒处方。

en: Mexican Revolution: The last of U.S. forces withdraw from Veracruz, occupied seven months earlier in response to the Tampico Affair.
zh: 墨西哥革命：最后一批美国军队撤出韦拉克鲁斯，该地此前七个月因坦皮科事件而被占领。

en: Johan Alfred Ander becomes the last person to be executed in Sweden.
zh: 约翰·阿尔弗雷德·安德成为瑞典被处决的最后一个人。

en: King William III of the Netherlands dies without a male heir and a special law is passed to allow his daughter Princess Wilhelmina to succeed him.
zh: 荷兰国王威廉三世去世时没有男性继承人，因此通过了一项特别法律，允许他的女儿威廉明娜公主继承王位。

en: Corrupt Tammany Hall leader William Magear Tweed (better known as Boss Tweed) is delivered to authorities in New York City after being captured in Spain.
zh: 腐败的塔玛尼政团领袖威廉·马吉尔·特威德（更广为人知的名字是“特威德老大”）在西班牙被捕后被移交给纽约市当局。

en: The Manchester Martyrs are hanged in Manchester, England, for killing a police officer while freeing two Irish Republican Brotherhood members from custody.
zh: 曼彻斯特烈士因在营救两名爱尔兰共和兄弟会成员脱离拘禁时杀害一名警察，而在英格兰曼彻斯特被处以绞刑。

en: American Civil War: Battle of Chattanooga begins: Union forces led by General Ulysses S. Grant reinforce troops at Chattanooga, Tennessee, and counter-attack Confederate troops.
zh: 美国内战：查塔努加战役打响：尤利塞斯·S·格兰特将军率领的联邦军在田纳西州查塔努加增援部队，并对邦联军发动反攻。

en: French and Poles defeat the Spanish at Battle of Tudela.
zh: 法国人和波兰人在图德拉战役中击败西班牙人。

en: The start of the 1733 slave insurrection on St. John in what was then the Danish West Indies.
zh: 1733 年圣约翰岛奴隶起义爆发，当时该岛属于丹麦西印度群岛。

en: John Milton publishes Areopagitica, a pamphlet decrying censorship.
zh: 约翰·弥尔顿出版了抨击审查制度的小册子《论出版自由》。

en: Marriage of king James VI of Scotland and Anne of Denmark.
zh: 苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世与丹麦的安妮成婚。

en: Conquest of Seville by Christian troops under King Ferdinand III of Castile.
zh: 卡斯蒂利亚国王斐迪南三世麾下的基督教军队征服塞维利亚。

en: Constantine X Doukas becomes Byzantine emperor, with his son Michael as nominal co-emperor and Michael Psellos as chief minister.
Phocas is crowned Byzantine emperor after a rebellion of the Thracian army against reigning emperor Maurice and after Phocas' rival Germanus has been rebuffed by the Greens.

16-year-old Gratian is proclaimed augustus following the death of his father Valentinian I, though a couple of days later his half-brother Valentinian is also proclaimed augustus and becomes his co-ruler.
Thespis of Icaria becomes the first recorded actor to portray a character on stage.
You must be willing to do what others won't do, to have what others won't have.
Nvidia had come under pressure from President Trump to reappoint Huang, whose comeback helped add $1tn to the company's stock value.
zh: 英伟达迫于特朗普总统的压力，要求重新任命黄仁勋，黄仁勋的回归帮助该公司的股价增加了 1 万亿美元。

en: Megaspeed has been accused of funneling AI chips to China after a former executive's affair with Jensen Huang became public.
zh: 在前高管与黄仁勋的恋情曝光后，Megaspeed 被指控向中国输送人工智能芯片。

en: German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.
zh: 德国媒体称，俄罗斯计划在未来几周内向太空发射一颗携带核弹头的卫星。

en: Ukraine's sinking of a Russian battleship at a port in Libya raises the stakes of the war a notch, writes Frank Gardner.
zh: 弗兰克·加德纳写道，乌克兰在利比亚港口击沉一艘俄罗斯战舰，使战争的风险上升了一个档次。

en: The promoter and broadcaster helped define the music tastes of Australians for decades.
zh: 几十年来，发起人和广播公司帮助定义了澳大利亚人的音乐品味。

en: The publisher of an essay on coercive control apologises for "an unfortunate and inappropriate communication".
zh: 一篇关于强制控制的文章的出版商为“一次不幸且不恰当的沟通”道歉。

en: The report says there are signs of possible contamination across almost all of Gaza as a result of Israel's actions.
zh: 报告称，有迹象表明，由于以色列的行动，几乎整个加沙地带都可能受到污染。

en: The UK is joined by several other nations in recognising an ICJ ruling that Myanmar carried out genocide.
zh: 英国与其他几个国家一起承认国际法院关于缅甸实施种族灭绝的裁决。

en: Interests of oil-producing countries, a US boycott and a dispute over finance may have torpedoed climate talks.
zh: 产油国的利益、美国的抵制以及金融争端可能破坏了气候谈判。

en: Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were reportedly given 74 lashes in Qom.
zh: 据报道，帕拉斯托·艾哈迈迪 (Parastoo Ahmadi)、三名音乐家和一名制作人在库姆被鞭打 74 下。

en: The impersonator, Canadian comedian Mark Critch, poked fun at the US president's search for a new press secretary and US-Canada trade talks.
zh: 模仿者是加拿大喜剧演员马克·克里奇，他对美国总统寻找新新闻秘书和美加贸易谈判进行了取笑。

en: Uebert Angel, a British-Zimbabwean national, leads a charismatic church with branches in several countries.
zh: 尤伯特·安杰尔 (Uebert Angel) 是一位英籍津巴布韦人，领导着一个在多个国家设有分会的魅力教会。

en: BBC's Lily Jamali reports from Nvidia's headquarters, where she gauges the reaction to Huang's return after Trump says he brokered a deal.
zh: BBC 的莉莉·贾玛利 (Lily Jamali) 在英伟达总部进行报道，她评估了在特朗普表示黄仁勋促成了一项交易后，人们对黄仁勋回归的反应。

en: ICE officers arrested two passengers, a father and daughter, as they were boarding a flight in Seattle on Saturday.
zh: 周六，ICE 官员逮捕了两名在西雅图登机的乘客，一对父女。

en: The official 2026 White House Christmas tree is an 18-foot fir from Silent Night Evergreens, a farm in Endeavor, Wisconsin.
zh: 2026 年白宫官方圣诞树是一棵 18 英尺高的冷杉，来自威斯康星州 Endeavour 的 Silent Night Evergreens 农场。

en: President Zelensky said a Russia warship was sunk, with a Russian cargo ship also hit.
zh: 泽连斯基总统表示，一艘俄罗斯军舰被击沉，一艘俄罗斯货船也被击沉。

en: South African communities tell the BBC of measures they're taking to keep women safe after a wave of horrific killings.
zh: 南非社区向英国广播公司讲述了在发生一波可怕的杀戮事件后他们为保护妇女安全而采取的措施。

en: The BBC meets the far-left protesters French President Emmanuel Macron says are trying to bring down the Republic.
zh: BBC 会见了极左抗议者，法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙称他们试图推翻共和国。

en: Days after resigning while mired in scandal of extra-marital affairs, Nvidia's Jensen Huang is making a remarkable return.
zh: 因陷入婚外情丑闻而辞职几天后，英伟达公司的黄仁勋正在以惊人的方式回归。

en: The COP31 summit in Antalya was the longest-running climate talks in UN history.
zh: 在安塔利亚举行的 COP31 峰会是联合国历史上持续时间最长的气候谈判。

en: AI employees in the industry's epicentre - San Francisco - worry that the sector is overheated.
zh: 该行业中心旧金山的人工智能员工担心该行业过热。

en: Hibiscus Rising, commemorating David Oluwale, is unveiled in Leeds.
zh: 纪念大卫·奥卢瓦勒的《芙蓉崛起》在利兹揭幕。

en: A terrorist attack on a Mosque in Al-Rawda, North Sinai, Egypt kills 311 people and injures 128.
zh: 埃及北西奈省阿尔劳达一座清真寺发生恐怖袭击，造成 311 人死亡、128 人受伤。

en: The government of Colombia and the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia–People's Army sign a revised peace deal, bringing an end to the country's more than 50-year-long civil war.
zh: 哥伦比亚政府和哥伦比亚革命武装力量人民军签署了修订后的和平协议，结束了该国长达 50 多年的内战。

en: A terrorist attack on a hotel in Al-Arish, Egypt, kills at least seven people and injures 12 others.
zh: 埃及阿里什一家酒店发生恐怖袭击，造成至少 7 人死亡、12 人受伤。

en: An explosion on a bus carrying Tunisian Presidential Guard personnel in Tunisia's capital Tunis leaves at least 14 people dead.
zh: 突尼斯首都突尼斯一辆载有突尼斯总统卫队人员的巴士发生爆炸，造成至少14人死亡。

en: Iran signs an interim agreement with the P5+1 countries, limiting its nuclear program in exchange for reduced sanctions.
zh: 伊朗与P5+1国家签署临时协议，限制其核计划以换取减少制裁。

en: A fire at a clothing factory in Dhaka, Bangladesh, kills at least 112 people.
zh: 孟加拉国达卡一家服装厂发生火灾，造成至少 112 人死亡。

en: The Avdhela Project, an Aromanian digital library and cultural initiative, is founded in Bucharest, Romania.
zh: Avdhela 项目是一个罗马尼亚数字图书馆和文化倡议，成立于罗马尼亚布加勒斯特。

en: Crossair Flight 3597 crashes in Bassersdorf near Zurich Airport, killing 24 people, including singer Melanie Thornton and two members of the German band Passion Fruit.
zh: Crossair 3597 航班在苏黎世机场附近的巴瑟斯多夫坠毁，造成 24 人死亡，其中包括歌手梅兰妮·桑顿和德国乐队 Passion Fruit 的两名成员。

en: China Southern Airlines Flight 3943 crashes on approach to Guilin Qifengling Airport in Guilin, China, killing all 141 people on board.
zh: 中国南方航空3943航班在飞往中国桂林七峰岭机场时坠毁，机上141人全部遇难。

en: The Çaldıran–Muradiye earthquake in eastern Turkey kills between 4,000 and 5,000 people.
zh: 土耳其东部的恰尔迪兰-穆拉迪耶地震造成 4,000 至 5,000 人死亡。

en: A national speed limit is imposed on the Autobahn in Germany because of the 1973 oil crisis. The speed limit lasts only four months.
zh: 由于 1973 年的石油危机，德国对高速公路实施了全国限速。限速仅持续四个月。

en: Apollo program: The Apollo 12 command module splashes down safely in the Pacific Ocean, ending the second crewed mission to land on the Moon.
zh: 阿波罗计划：阿波罗 12 号指令舱安全落入太平洋，结束了第二次载人登月任务。

en: Bulgarian TABSO Flight 101 crashes near Bratislava, Czechoslovakia, killing all 82 people on board.
zh: 保加利亚TABSO 101航班在捷克斯洛伐克布拉迪斯拉发附近坠毁，机上82人全部遇难。

en: Cold War: The West Berlin branch of the Socialist Unity Party of Germany forms a separate party, the Socialist Unity Party of West Berlin.
zh: 冷战：德国统一社会党的西柏林支部组建了一个独立的政党，即西柏林统一社会党。

en: The influential British satirical television programme That Was the Week That Was is first broadcast.
zh: 英国颇具影响力的讽刺电视节目《That Was the Week That Was》首播。

en: World War II: The 73rd Bombardment Wing launches the first attack on Tokyo from the Northern Mariana Islands.
zh: 第二次世界大战：第 73 轰炸联队从北马里亚纳群岛对东京发动首次攻击。

en: World War II: At the battle of Makin the USS Liscome Bay is torpedoed near Tarawa and sinks, killing 650 men.
zh: 第二次世界大战：在马金战役中，利斯科姆湾号航空母舰在塔拉瓦附近被鱼雷击沉，造成 650 人死亡。

en: World War II: The United States grants Lend-Lease to the Free French Forces.
zh: 第二次世界大战：美国向自由法国军队提供租借法案。

en: World War II: The First Slovak Republic becomes a signatory to the Tripartite Pact, officially joining the Axis powers.
zh: 第二次世界大战：斯洛伐克第一共和国签署三方条约，正式加入轴心国。

en: The Senegalese Socialist Party holds its second congress.
zh: 塞内加尔社会党召开第二次代表大会。

en: In Washington, D.C., the FBI Scientific Crime Detection Laboratory (better known as the FBI Crime Lab) officially opens.
zh: 在华盛顿特区，联邦调查局科学犯罪侦查实验室（更广为人知的名称是联邦调查局犯罪实验室）正式开业。

en: Nine Irish Republican Army members are executed by an Irish Free State firing squad. Among them is author Erskine Childers, who had been arrested for illegally carrying a revolver.
zh: 九名爱尔兰共和军成员被爱尔兰自由邦行刑队处决。其中包括作家厄斯金·柴尔德斯（Erskine Childers），他因非法携带左轮手枪而被捕。

en: Anna Sewell's animal welfare novel Black Beauty is published.
zh: 安娜·休厄尔的动物福利小说《黑美人》出版。

en: British naturalist Charles Darwin's On the Origin of Species is published.
zh: 英国博物学家查尔斯·达尔文的《物种起源》出版。

en: Danish troops defeat a Schleswig-Holstein force in the town of Lottorf, Schleswig-Holstein.
zh: 丹麦军队在石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因州洛托夫镇击败了石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因州军队。

en: The Texas Provincial Government authorizes the creation of a horse-mounted police force called the Texas Rangers (which is now the Texas Ranger Division of the Texas Department of Public Safety).
zh: 德克萨斯州政府授权建立一支名为德克萨斯游骑兵队（现为德克萨斯州公共安全部德克萨斯游骑兵分部）的骑马警察部队。

en: South Carolina passes the Ordinance of Nullification, declaring that the Tariffs of 1828 and 1832 were null and void in the state, beginning the Nullification Crisis.
zh: 南卡罗来纳州通过了《废止条例》，宣布 1828 年和 1832 年的关税在该州无效，引发了“废止危机”。

en: Tarabai, regent of the Maratha Empire, imprisons Rajaram II of Satara for refusing to remove Balaji Baji Rao from the post of peshwa.
zh: 马拉塔帝国摄政王塔拉拜因拒绝解除巴拉吉·巴吉·拉奥的佩什瓦职务而监禁了萨塔拉的拉贾拉姆二世。

en: Abel Tasman becomes the first European to discover the island Van Diemen's Land (later renamed Tasmania).
zh: 亚伯·塔斯曼成为第一个发现范迪门岛（后更名为塔斯马尼亚）的欧洲人。

en: Battle of Solway Moss: An English army defeats a much larger Scottish force near the River Esk in Dumfries and Galloway.
zh: 索尔韦莫斯之战：一支英国军队在邓弗里斯和加洛韦的埃斯克河附近击败了一支规模大得多的苏格兰军队。

en: Hundred Years' War: Joan of Arc unsuccessfully besieges La Charité.
zh: 百年战争：圣女贞德围攻拉夏里特失败。

en: Peter I of Cyprus ascends the throne of Cyprus after his father, Hugh IV of Cyprus, abdicates.
zh: 塞浦路斯的彼得一世在其父亲塞浦路斯的休四世退位后登上塞浦路斯王位。

en: David II is annointed as king of Scotland, but has to spent most of his reign outside Scotland.
zh: 大卫二世被任命为苏格兰国王，但他的大部分统治时间都必须在苏格兰境外度过。

en: An overnight landslide on the north side of Mont Granier, one of the largest historical rockslope failures ever recorded in Europe, destroys five villages.
zh: 格兰尼尔山北侧夜间发生的山体滑坡摧毁了五个村庄，这是欧洲历史上有记录的最大的岩坡崩塌之一。

en: Gąsawa massacre: At an assembly of Piast dukes at Gąsawa, Polish Prince Leszek the White, Duke Henry the Bearded and others are attacked by assassins while bathing.
zh: 加萨瓦大屠杀：在加萨瓦举行的皮雅斯特公爵集会上，波兰王子莱谢克·白、大胡子亨利公爵和其他人在洗澡时遭到刺客袭击。

en: Genghis Khan defeats the renegade Khwarazmian prince Jalal al-Din at the Battle of the Indus, completing the Mongol conquest of Central Asia.
zh: 成吉思汗在印度河之战中击败了叛变的花剌子模王子贾拉勒丁，完成了蒙古对中亚的征服。

en: The army of the Fourth Crusade take Zara for Venice in order to pay for the debts to the Venetians.
zh: 第四次十字军东征的军队将扎拉带到威尼斯，以偿还威尼斯人的债务。

en: Conrad of Montferrat becomes King of Jerusalem upon his marriage to Isabella I of Jerusalem.
zh: 蒙费拉特的康拉德与耶路撒冷的伊莎贝拉一世结婚后成为耶路撒冷国王。

en: An earthquake hits Syria, causing multiple casualties and damages in Antioch, Damascus and Mosul.
Election of pope Anastasius II following the death of pope Gelasius I a few days prior.
Theodosius I makes his adventus, or formal entry, into Constantinople.
Education breeds confidence. Confidence breeds hope. Hope breeds peace.
